items.question: Under the UAE federal law on combatting communicable diseases, within how many hours must doctors and medical professionals report a person suffering from or who died of a communicable disease?
items.fact: Doctors must report communicable disease cases within 24 hours.

items.question: What is the maximum fine under the UAE resolution on sharing health information on communicable diseases for publishing false or misleading health information?
items.fact: Publishing false health information carries fine up to AED 20,000.
